name: recipe_sale_alert
description: Autonomy recipe: reminds you when a sale or order email arrives from Selar or Paystack. Use for 'tell me when I make a sale', 'set up sale alerts', 'watch my email for orders'.
instructions: 1. Call background_agents with action 'create', name 'Sale alert', trigger_type 'mail_match', trigger_config {"query": "from:(selar.co OR selar.com OR paystack.com) (sale OR order OR payment OR purchase) newer_than:2d"}, steps [{"tool": "create_reminder", "input": {"text": "New sale or order email from {sender}: {subject}. Check your store and deliver if needed.", "due_in_minutes": 5}}], max_runs_per_day 30, enabled false. 2. enabled false makes it start switched OFF; never call background_agents with action 'enable' yourself in this recipe. If it says an agent with that name already existed, its on/off state was kept: tell the user that. Tell the user: it's set up but off; they can test it once from Toolbox -> Background agents (Run) and switch it on there when happy. Changing agents only works from the PC, so if this was asked from the phone, say that and stop. This recipe only creates reminders; it never replies, refunds, delivers or opens links.
